# req v0.6.2 - Table of Contents

## Pages

- [Req](https://req.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [CHANGELOG](https://req.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [Req](https://req.hexdocs.pm/Req.md): The high-level API.
- [Req.Request](https://req.hexdocs.pm/Req.Request.md): The low-level API and the request struct.
- [Req.Response](https://req.hexdocs.pm/Req.Response.md): The response struct.
- [Req.Response.Async](https://req.hexdocs.pm/Req.Response.Async.md): Asynchronous response body.
- [Req.Steps](https://req.hexdocs.pm/Req.Steps.md): The collection of built-in steps.
- [Req.Tar](https://req.hexdocs.pm/Req.Tar.md): Tar archive decoding.

- [Req.Test](https://req.hexdocs.pm/Req.Test.md): Req testing conveniences.
- [Req.ZIP](https://req.hexdocs.pm/Req.ZIP.md): ZIP archive decoding.

- Exceptions
  - [Req.ArchiveError](https://req.hexdocs.pm/Req.ArchiveError.md): Represents an error when unpacking archives fails, returned by `Req.Steps.decode_body/1`.

  - [Req.ChecksumMismatchError](https://req.hexdocs.pm/Req.ChecksumMismatchError.md): Represents a checksum mismatch error returned by `Req.Steps.checksum/1`.

  - [Req.DecompressError](https://req.hexdocs.pm/Req.DecompressError.md): Represents an error when decompression fails, returned by `Req.Steps.decompress_body/1`.

  - [Req.HTTPError](https://req.hexdocs.pm/Req.HTTPError.md): Represents an HTTP protocol error.
  - [Req.Test.OwnershipError](https://req.hexdocs.pm/Req.Test.OwnershipError.md)
  - [Req.TooManyRedirectsError](https://req.hexdocs.pm/Req.TooManyRedirectsError.md): Represents an error when too many redirects occured, returned by `Req.Steps.redirect/1`.

  - [Req.TransportError](https://req.hexdocs.pm/Req.TransportError.md): Represents an error with the transport used by an HTTP connection.
